title: Mixed dinner
text: The mushroom risotto was perfection, but the service was painfully slow. The atmosphere was cozy though.

title: Coffee shop
text: The coffee was bitter and cold. However, the baristas were very friendly and the outdoor seating is lovely.

title: Negation
text: The food was not bad at all, but the waiter was not friendly and the wine list is not great.

title: Bakery
text: Fresh bagels and donuts every morning. The prices are reasonable, but the parking lot is always packed.

title: Takeout
text: Delivery was quick and the pad thai was delicious, but the spring rolls arrived soggy.

title: Hotel brunch
text: The buffet is fresh and never disappoints. The staff were attentive, although the music was far too loud.

title: Sarcasm (hard)
text: Oh great, another burnt pizza. Love waiting forty minutes for cold fries.

title: Pizzeria
text: Crispy crust, generous toppings and a cheerful owner. The dessert menu was disappointing.

title: Steakhouse
text: My steak was cooked perfectly and the sides were tasty, but the bill was outrageous for the portion size.

title: Ramen bar
text: The broth is rich and flavorful. Seating is cramped and the line out the door is ridiculous.
